stem: Which statement most accurately describes immunosuppression in pediatric patients who receive transplants or chemotherapy?

options.text: It can be an intended therapeutic goal, such as preventing rejection of a donor organ or stem cell transplant, and can also result from chemotherapy or HSCT conditioning
It is always an unintended side effect of treatment
It results only from chemotherapy and never from HSCT conditioning
It is only ever an intended goal and never a consequence of treatment
